title: Quantitative Data Reconciliation
description: Reconcile reported quantitative results by locating primary sources, accessing raw data/code and independently recomputing the numbers. The pack enforces numeric independence before any assertive claim ceiling.

common_failure_modes.note: Numeric claim accepted from the source without independent recomputation.
No raw data or analysis code located, so recomputation is impossible to verify.
Compared objects or denominators are not equivalent, producing a false reconciliation.
Multiple 'independent' reports derive from one primary chain.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed BOUNDED_STRONG
recomputation conflicts with source and cannot be resolved

stop_criteria.condition: numeric claim independently recomputed and matches source within declared tolerance; obligations satisfied
stop_criteria.note: Bounded strong result may be candidate only after external review.

stop_criteria.condition: raw data/code inaccessible and no independent replication available after search
stop_criteria.note: Honest insufficient-evidence conclusion, not a forced match.

stop_criteria.condition: negative or contradictory results never searched
